User.title: User
User.description: User profile document containing account credentials, public identity, and virtual coin balance.

bdpId.description: Permanent sequential BD PARTY ID in the format BDP000001.

username.description: Display name or handle chosen by the user.

email.description: Email address associated with the account.

photoUrl.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

bio.description: User profile biography or status description.

role.description: User permission role. Defaults to USER for all new accounts.

coins.description: In-app virtual coin balance. Initialized to 0 and immutable by normal client updates.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last modified.

Counter.title: Counter
Counter.description: System counter used for sequential permanent BD PARTY ID generation.

lastBdpNumber.description: The latest generated numeric sequence for BDP ID.

RoleRequest.title: RoleRequest
RoleRequest.description: Application submitted by a user for special roles or verification (HOST, MODERATOR, OFFICIAL, ASSISTANT_ADMIN, ADMIN).

requesterBdpId.description: Permanent BDP ID of the applicant.

requesterUsername.description: Username of the applicant at time of submission.

currentRole.description: Role held by the applicant at submission.

reason.description: Why the user is applying for this role.

experience.description: Prior experience relevant to the role.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the application was submitted.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when the application was reviewed.

reviewNote.description: Feedback or reason for decision from the reviewer.

Room.title: Room
Room.description: Live real-time voice room document with WebRTC stage configuration.

hostBdpId.description: BD PARTY ID of the host.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: Active participant or listener presence inside a room.

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user profiles stored by Firebase UID.

/system/{counterId}.description: System counters for BDP ID sequence generation.

/roleRequests/{requestId}.description: Role and verification applications submitted by users.

/rooms/{roomId}/participants/{uid}.description: Live participants and speakers inside the voice room.
